## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was that the pytz timezone database files had been corrupted. All timezone files in `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/pytz/zoneinfo/` were replaced with a 10-byte file containing just the text "CORRUPTED".

The fix was to copy the proper timezone data files from the system's zoneinfo directory (`/usr/share/zoneinfo/`) to restore the pytz timezone data. This restored the proper binary timezone files needed for pytz to function correctly.

After the fix, all previously failing tests now pass.
